$comment: editor-ia-starter-kit settings. The agent reads this file at the start of every task. Keys never go here; they go in .env.

$profiles.solo: One Claude Opus 5.5 agent does everything: taste, design, cuts, render.
$profiles.team: Claude Opus 5.5 orchestrates and makes every design decision. Claude Haiku 5.5 subagents run mechanical, parallel work: transcripts, probes, validators, contact sheets.

transcription.$languages: Languages spoken in your footage: ["es"], ["en"] or ["en","es"]. One language picks a fixed Whisper model; both lets Whisper detect per file.

$providers.whisper: npm run transcribe -- <video>  (local, free, no key; reads languages above)

defaults.$goal: personal | sell | grow. Empty means the agent asks per project.

music.$comment: Drop royalty-free tracks you own the rights to in music/ (or brands/<slug>/music/ for one brand). The agent picks from there when no music key is set.
